messages.content: Before I leave, please do one final check on St. Louis. Did the Drury actually join Wednesday night to the first reservation, and am I staying in the same room?

Yes. The hotel has linked the original July 20-22 stay with confirmation DRY-72023A for July 22-23. Both records now show one continuous stay in the same Deluxe King, and the room-move note has been removed.
Good. Confirm the complete hotel amount and the checkout date, not just the added night.
The first two nights total $391.64 and Wednesday night totals $244.18, both including taxes. The complete three-night hotel cost is $635.82, with checkout Thursday, July 23 at 11:00 a.m.
Now walk through Thursday. The museum expects to release me at noon, and my Delta flight leaves at 3:42 p.m.

After the 11:00 a.m. hotel checkout, you can take your luggage to the museum. With a noon release, leaving the museum by 12:15 p.m. should put you at STL around 12:40-12:55 p.m., allowing roughly 2 hours 45 minutes before departure.
Allow a little time for the handoff to run over. What is the latest sensible departure from the museum?

I would treat 12:30 p.m. as the latest sensible departure. Even with a 35-minute ride, that reaches the terminal around 1:05 p.m., leaving about 2 hours 35 minutes before the 3:42 p.m. nonstop to Atlanta. A release later than 12:30 would start reducing the buffer for traffic, bag drop, and security.
That works. Give me the final status and total once more.

Everything is confirmed: one continuous Drury stay from Monday, July 20 through Thursday, July 23 in the same Deluxe King, checkout at 11:00 a.m., and a complete hotel total of $635.82. Delta confirmation D6R8KP departs STL Thursday at 3:42 p.m. and arrives ATL at 6:18 p.m. Plan to leave the museum by 12:30 p.m. after the expected noon release. The full expected trip total remains $1,173.82, including the $70.00 ground transportation allowance.
